entities.summary: The Bosque de Zárate Reserved Zone is a protected area in Peru. It is located in the Huarochirí Province of the Lima Region. The area was designated as a reserved zone on October 13, 2010, by Ministerial Resolution No. 195-2010-MINAM. It covers an area of approximately 545.75 ha.
